name: Chemin de Stevenson
description_md:
Chemin de Stevenson is a 228.0 km waymarked hiking route located in France. The trail is signposted as GR 70 and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network.

This hard route involves 6301 m of ascent and 7041 m of descent. The difficulty is derived from the distance and ascent. Walkers should plan for about 75 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule to complete the journey.
